score_note: Unfinished DX11 full-resolution native menu/car/race renderer; 01071 implements one source-stage continuity repair. Regression/CI/C6 are same-feature changes, not separately scored. Account AI2 scoreboard baseline remains 1963.
summary: Move the bounded 2048-primitive mesh snapshot check after proven D3D9 zero-write/scissor-clipped and isolated offscreen menu/car/race Draw/DrawIndexed observer cases. Authentic pixel-neutral large commands consume their exact game source ordinals without synthetic GPU Draw; unknown topologies and any unrepresentable pixel-producing large Draw still abort the native full-frame publication. DX9Ex game Draw/input/FFB retained. Existing 01070 feature contract plus 00755/00764 order-dependent negative tests repaired. Source stage and five exact-SHA Actions verified; actual HMD/game output UNTESTED.

feature_contract.goal: Integrate game-authored native Draw/DrawIndexed across large pixel-neutral menu/car/race source commands without losing full-resolution source ordinals, preserving bounded GPU admission, original D3D9Ex fallbacks, and the five mandatory exact-SHA GitHub Actions gates. Full-playable game/HMD parity remains unfinished.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Authenticated zero-write clipped/offscreen game Draws keep their exact original source ordinals without fake native GPU draws.
True pixel-producing menu/car/race Draw and DrawIndexed continue through the existing primitive mesh cap and live native shader/resource binding.
Unknown topologies or oversized pixel writers cannot publish an incomplete native frame and leave original D3D9 Draw/input/FFB unchanged.
The five unmodified mandatory GitHub Actions pass against the same validation-bearing source SHA; no HMD/game output is inferred.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: The existing 00755/00764 scoped source regressions and DX11 Fast Structural Checks succeeded at validation SHA 44a2133c.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Malformed topology, oversized true pixel-producing native mesh, absent source color Clear, lost ordinal and scissor mutations all remain negative controls; native fallback preserved.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Live D3D9 Draw/Indexed observer chooses provable no-target-write before native mesh read, while native Draw shader/resources and full-frame Present remain opt-in and fail closed. Full native menu/car/race HMD UNTESTED.

development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: NativeDrawPathActive=false by default; unsupported draws abort native publication, original game D3D9Ex rendering, gamepad, FFB and SkyGlow remain authoritative; DXVK remains frozen.
